description:
Theseus's own gate and dedup parse review prose (contracts from the format audit, at theseus main 360cead):
- T2 review_check.py (~:20-23, :89-90, :138-146): a SHIP is receipt-backed only if the body STARTS with `### review-verdict: <state> for `<40hex>``.
- T5 dedup.py (~:13, :30, :46) and cli.py (~:299): thread first line must match `^**<Severity>**: <title>$`; that raw first line (300 chars) is passed to the reviewer as the dispute title (render.py ~:341).
This item adds dual-read so the next release can change the writer (theseus-review-verdict-body-redesign-20261110, theseus-review-thread-ids-footer-20261110):
1. Define and accept a hidden verdict marker `<!-- review-verdict: v2 <state> <40hex> -->`: exactly one, anywhere in the body; the heading form stays accepted. A body with both must agree on state and SHA, else not receipt-backed. Model text cannot forge it (verdict.py already neutralises `<!--`/`-->` in model text; add a test).
2. Accept the thread title line in both forms: `**<Severity>**: <title>` and `<mark> **<Severity>** · D<n> · <title>` (mark ∈ 🔴 🟠 🟡 🔵 ⚪). The fingerprint (`<!-- review-finding: … -->`, dedup.py ~:16-31) keeps hashing the full title exactly as today, so existing threads still dedupe.
3. The dispute prompt title comes from the parsed title, never the raw decorated first line.
4. Write a consumer-facing doc page defining the marker grammar (review-protocol, review-verdict v2, review-defect, review-finding, review-local-record) as the supported machine interface and stating that prose is presentation and may change.
Writer behaviour does NOT change in this item: current bodies and threads are byte-identical (goldens unchanged).
Guardrails: never change the review-protocol record, review-defect or review-finding marker formats; never relax T6 (no bot review or thread may be edited); no live model calls; no owner-only actions. Theseus merge rule: current-head review-verdict SHIP from theseus-review[bot] plus green required checks, AND an independent review because this changes gate receipt and dedup parsing. Work in its own worktree ../theseus.wt-<slug> from origin/main.
